description: Run by the self-hosted Renovate in proxmox-three (platform/renovate), Mondays 06:00 UK - that job is the only schedule. PRs auto-merge once the required build check passes, majors excepted (merged by hand); Dockerfile changes then release themselves (see .github/workflows/build.yml)
